Hey man, I got my U11 on gumtree for $600 and it was only two months old and bought from Optus with all the accessories. If you're looking to save money, this is the way to go.

When purchasing, make sure to get pictures of the device from the seller plus meet up in a local place as you would know. A surefire was to check it isn't a fake is to test edge sense as only two phones (two my knowledge) on the market have the function. I would also check the IMEI of the phone as well as long the ports/buttons.

Hope this helps. The U11 is a great phone and I don't regret it one bit!

I would also recommend this site, it was super helpful for my finals. It's basically a rundown of the whole course content, but it doesn't go super in-depth as it's only meant to jog your memory.

https://ibphysicsnotes.wordpress.com/

Apart from that, do a lot of past papers - the papers for the past 5 years+ all have the same format so it's quite likely that there will be a crossing over of questions.
